product_overview: A frontend application for educators and administrators to log in, manage tests, add MCQ questions, and publish assessments. The app provides a structured 5-page workflow for creating, editing, reviewing, and managing tests.
core_goals: Sign in to access the test management workspace
View, create, edit, and delete tests from a central dashboard
Configure test details including subject, topics, marking scheme, difficulty, and duration
Add MCQ questions manually or by CSV import
Preview and publish a test, then return to the dashboard

features.name: User Login
features.description: Authenticate with a user ID and password to access protected areas of the application.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter user ID -> Enter password -> Submit the login form -> See the dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Submit the login form with empty fields -> See validation errors
Navigate to /login -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit the login form -> See an error alert

features.name: Dashboard Test List
features.description: Review all available tests in a table and perform common test management actions.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View the test list with test details -> Sort or filter the table -> Open a test for editing, viewing, or deletion
Navigate to /dashboard -> Start creating a new test -> Move to the test creation flow
Navigate to /dashboard -> Delete a test -> See confirmation feedback after the deletion

features.name: Create and Edit Test
features.description: Set up or modify a test by entering metadata, choosing subject structure, and configuring scoring and timing.
user_flows: Navigate to /task-create -> Enter test name -> Select a subject -> Choose test type -> Select topics and sub-topics -> Set difficulty -> Configure correct, wrong, and unattempted marks -> Set duration and total marks -> Save the test as a draft
Navigate to /task-create -> Enter test name -> Select a subject -> Choose test type -> Select topics and sub-topics -> Set difficulty -> Configure marks and duration -> Continue to add questions

features.name: Add Questions and Publish Test
features.description: Build the question set for a test, review it, configure publishing settings, and publish the test.
user_flows: Navigate to /task-create/add-question -> Enter question text -> Enter four options -> Select the correct answer -> Add an explanation -> Save the question
Navigate to /task-create/add-question -> Enter question details -> Add another question -> Repeat question entry -> Review the question list
Navigate to /task-create/add-question -> Upload a CSV file -> Import questions in bulk -> Review imported questions
Navigate to /task-create/add-question -> Switch to preview mode -> Review test content -> Configure publish settings -> Publish the test -> Return to the dashboard

features.name: Protected Navigation and Layout
features.description: Use the authenticated layout to move between protected sections of the app and handle access restrictions.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard while signed in -> View the protected layout -> Move between dashboard and test creation from the sidebar
Navigate to /dashboard while not signed in -> Get redirected to /login

routes.description: Redirects to dashboard when authenticated, otherwise login flow applies
User authentication page with userId and password fields
Test list dashboard with create, edit, view, and delete actions
Create or edit test configuration including subject, topics, marking scheme, and duration
Add MCQ questions, import CSV, and publish test preview

features.name: User Login
features.description: Authenticate with userId and password; JWT stored in localStorage and redirects to dashboard
user_interactions: Fill User ID input field
Fill Password input field
Click Login button to submit
See validation errors when fields are empty
See error alert on invalid credentials
Redirect to dashboard on successful login

features.name: Dashboard Test List
features.description: View all tests in a sortable/filterable table with CRUD actions
user_interactions: View test list table with name, subject, topics, status, and created date
Click Create New Test button to start test creation
Click edit icon to modify an existing test
Click view icon to open test in read-only mode
Click delete icon to remove a test
See snackbar feedback after delete operations

features.name: Create and Edit Test
features.description: Configure test metadata, marking scheme, duration, and difficulty before adding questions
user_interactions: Enter test name
Select subject from autocomplete dropdown
Choose test type tabs
Select topics and sub-topics
Set difficulty level
Configure correct, wrong, and unattempted marks
Set duration and total marks
Click Save as Draft or Next to proceed to add questions

features.name: Add Questions and Publish Test
features.description: Add MCQ questions manually or via CSV import, preview test, and publish
user_interactions: Fill question text, four options, correct answer, and explanation
Add another question or save current question
Edit or delete existing questions in the list
Upload CSV file to bulk import questions
Switch to publish preview mode
Configure publish settings and publish test
Return to dashboard after publish

features.name: Protected Navigation and Layout
features.description: Sidebar and navbar navigation with auth guard for protected routes
user_interactions: Access protected routes only when token exists in localStorage
Get redirected to login when unauthenticated
Navigate between dashboard and test creation via sidebar

known_limitations.issue: Login fallback credentials in authApi use vedant-admin/vedant123 but UI error message references admin/password
known_limitations.impact: Demo fallback login may not work if remote API is unavailable due to response shape mismatch (success vs status)

known_limitations.issue: App uses basename /taskmanagementsystem/ for GitHub Pages deployment
known_limitations.impact: Local E2E tests must use full base path when navigating routes

known_limitations.issue: Backend API is external staging server; tests depend on network availability
known_limitations.impact: API failures may block flows that require live data such as subjects and test list
